about: Ways down into the Ruien from the street (docs/ruien-native.md, Entrances). One entry per entrance: the kit (RuienEntrance.cs) builds the door, the stair and the closed landing from it. World metres, +x north, +z east. 'door' is the middle of the doorway on the wall's face at street level, 'out' the face's normal toward the street. Chosen by Steve 2026-11-02 from the RE-entrances survey (its number is 'survey').

entrances.name: Rode Poort gate house door
entrances.head: flat
entrances.note: Carts pass through the gate passage 4 m away: the door must open inward.; the drawn door is replaced by the kit's oak frame and leaf under the old hood

entrances.head: flat
entrances.name: Side door in the Sint-Jorispoort passage
entrances.note: In the passage's north wall (house 677, no interior); the stair runs west inside the house, the landing's grille faces the gallery 5 m north. The leaf opens into the stair: the passage stays clear.

entrances.head: flat
entrances.name: Side door in the passage by the Keizerspoort
entrances.note: In the passage's north wall (house 308, no interior); the stair runs east toward the Keizersrui gallery under the street (5 m from the landing's grille); the sluice keeper's stair S18 is 16 m north.

entrances.head: flat
entrances.name: Side door in the gateway on the Kanaalrui
entrances.note: In the passage's east wall (house 395, no interior); the stair runs south toward the Kanaalrui gallery under the canal street, the landing bricked up facing it.

entrances.head: flat
entrances.name: Side door in the covered passage by Sint-Jansplein
entrances.note: In the passage's north wall (house 287, no interior); the stair runs west toward the Jacobsrui under the street; the inn's cellar hatch on the pavement (x -26) stays clear north of the stair.

entrances.head: flat
entrances.name: Cellar door in a cottage gable on the Kipdorprui
entrances.note: Between the gable's two windows; a steep cellar stair straight in across the cottage (no interior); its top runs on into the empty house behind (568, no interior); the landing bricked up facing the Kipdorprui under the front street.

entrances.head: flat
entrances.name: Side door in a house wall on the Paulusrui
entrances.note: On the plain side wall round the corner from the wine shop front (house 755, no interior); the stair runs north inside the house, the landing's grille faces the Paulusrui under the street.

entrances.head: flat
entrances.name: Cellar door in a cottage gable on the Kanaalrui
entrances.note: Between the gable's two windows, the pump 4 m off; a steep cellar stair straight in (no interior), the landing bricked up facing the Kanaalrui to the south.

entrances.head: flat
entrances.name: Cellar door in a cottage gable on the Entrepotrui
entrances.note: Between the gable's two windows; the cottage is 3.7 m deep, so the stair's top runs on into the empty cottage behind (1021, no interior); the landing bricked up facing the Entrepotrui.

entrances.name: Stair-house on the Steenplein
entrances.head: arch
entrances.note: On the Steenplein by the trees, 6 m from the Suikerrui gallery (room for the gate's niche); the door faces the square, clear of the quay lanes and goods piles; the Werf watch walks round it.

entrances.name: Stair-house on the Werf
entrances.head: arch
entrances.note: On the Werf square, the stair along the Werfrui gallery; the door faces the open square.

entrances.name: Stair-house on the Rijnkaai
entrances.head: arch
entrances.note: Aligned with the quay flagstone courses. Reserved city-works apron; the full roof, drainage and 1.6 m door approach stay outside railways, crane tracks and the fixed vehicle corridors.

entrances.name: Stair-house by Sint-Paulus
entrances.head: arch
entrances.note: Retired street obstruction. The connected R1 facade doorway serves Sint-Paulus; retain this permanent survey ID.

entrances.name: Stair-house on the green by the Hanseatic House
entrances.head: arch
entrances.note: Turned to the south side of the rui and moved 6 m: the survey spot was hard by an elm. The door faces north onto the green.

entrances.name: Stair-house on the Kipdorp green
entrances.head: arch
entrances.note: On the Kipdorp green, the stair along the Kipdorprui; the door faces east, clear of the elm; the children's chalk pitch finds free green beside it.

entrances.name: Stair-house on the green by the Stadspark
entrances.head: arch
entrances.note: On the green by the Stadspark, the stair along the Vestrui; the door faces west onto the path; the children's chalk pitch finds free green beside it.

entrances.name: Stair-house on the Lijnwaadmarkt
entrances.head: arch
entrances.note: On the Lijnwaadmarkt, the stair along the Lijnwaadrui gallery, off the paths and benches.

entrances.name: R1 city-works cellar door
entrances.head: flat
entrances.notes: Reuses the decorative doorway of house 82, outside the bakery shopfront. Native house 82 has no authored interior. Original stone surround and fanlight retained; inward-opening oak leaf replaces the closed decorative leaf.

entrances.name: O2 cellar door beside Vleeshuis
entrances.head: flat
entrances.notes: Existing decorative house 579 doorway, outside the neighbouring shop. Inward leaf and buried stair; side arch opens onto a supported maintenance walk joining the existing hall bridge. Replaces both unsafe road hatches. The projecting 260 mm threshold is lowered to a 25 mm worn sill within the retained surround.
